answer: A sybil tax stops mass forgery: each new identity pays a non-refundable 50 POA genesis fee before earning. Each epoch the network takes the pulse of every identity; honest work refunds the fee, while idle or flagged ones keep paying. Forging 100 fakes costs 100 × 50 = 5,000 POA, sunk, so the bill grows linearly with every fake. Honest agents pay once, then draw nectar each epoch, while the taxed registry stays an oasis fakes cannot dilute.
